name: New remote jobs to Google Sheets (daily)

parameters.content:
## Set these 3 things before the first run

1. **Apify token**: open *Run Remote Jobs Scraper*, create a **Header Auth** credential named `Apify API token` with Name `Authorization` and Value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (token: Apify Console > Settings > API & Integrations).
2. **Google Sheets**: open *Append rows to Google Sheet*, connect your Google account, and replace `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SPREADSHEET_URL` with the URL of an **empty** spreadsheet. The first run writes the header row.
3. **What to search**: edit the JSON body of the HTTP node (boards, `titleKeywords`, `categories`, `locationsAllowed`, `minSalaryUsd`...). Field list: see the repo README.

Then activate the workflow. The first run lists up to 100 current jobs as `new` (it creates the baseline); after that each run appends only jobs it has not seen before.

## 300-second limit

This node uses Apify's `run-sync-get-dataset-items` endpoint, which answers **408 after 300 seconds** (the node timeout is 310 s so you see Apify's answer). The default input (4 boards, no descriptions) finishes in well under a minute. Adding `fourdayweek` (about 100 polite requests) can push a run past the limit.

`maxTotalChargeUsd=0.50` in the query caps the cost of one run. Jobs that did not fit are delivered by the next run.

Uses the Remote Jobs Scraper Actor by Cedarfetch Labs on Apify (pay per result).
https://apify.com/cedarfetch/remote-jobs-scraper
